My body is wrinkled and bent over; My back is curved like a roof-ridge. My eyes are bleary and sightless; My head is bald and shaven. Taking up pestles,
the young men pound grain,
supporting their wives and children.
Young men acquire wealth.
Perform the teaching of the Buddha,
by doing which one does not regret it later.
Quickly wash your feet and sit down to one side,
devoted to the tranquility of the mind.
"Follow the teaching of the Buddha.
Having heard those words of hers,
the instruction of Paṭācārā,
Having washed their feet,
they sat down to one side,
devoted to mental tranquility.
They carried out the Buddha’s teaching.
During the first watch of the night,
they recollected their previous births.
In the middle watch of the night,
they purified the divine eye;
in the final watch of the night,
They shattered the mass of darkness.
Rising up, they bowed at his feet and said,
"Your instruction has been fulfilled."
Just as the thirty-three gods place Indra at their head when he is undefeated in battle,
so shall we dwell with him honored before us.
“We possess the threefold knowledge and are free from taints.
Thus it was that thirty bhikkhunī elders declared their final knowledge in the presence of Paṭācārā.
